name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 4V — WSON

selection_hints: Selecting a 4V LDO linear regulator IC in SMD packaging.
Using Tier-A symbols from KiCad library such as TLV75740PDRV.
avoid_when: The design requires a voltage other than 4V.

Through-hole or non-WSON packaging is required.
